Trump Hails Strike on Iranian Bridge, Warning ‘More to Follow’
item.summary: Iran state media said eight people had been killed in the attack and dozens wounded. A local official said the bridge, in the mountains, was not yet in operation and that the people had been nearby when the attack happened.

item.title: Trump Says He’ll End the Iran War in Weeks. What If He Can’t?

item.title: War With Iran Clarifies Trump’s Spending Priorities: The Military, Not Child Care
item.summary: As the White House prepares to release its 2027 budget, President Trump said military protection, not social programs, took precedence.

item.title: Mortgage Rates Climb for 5th Week as Iran War Weighs on U.S. Housing Market
item.summary: The average rate on a 30-year mortgage in the United States jumped to 6.46 percent, making it harder for buyers to afford homes.

item.title: Macron Snaps Back at Trump, Reflecting Europe’s Growing Anger Over Iran
